posts.hook: Fix coding errors faster with this AI debugging prompt

steps: Paste the full error, the code around it, and what you expected to happen into Claude or ChatGPT.
Ask it to rank the three most likely causes before it writes any fix.
Ask for a tiny test that proves the bug is gone, so the fix doesn't quietly break something else.
posts.take: Ask for the cause first. The fix comes easy after.

say: Fix coding errors way faster with this AI debugging trick!
Paste an error and say fix it, and you get a guess. Give it the right context, and you get the real cause.

posts.prompt: Six Generative Fill scene prompts that work for product photos. Tip. Match the light direction in the prompt to the light already on your product, and add a soft contact shadow if one is missing.
